about: The device API catalogue: the single source of docs/apis.md (node tools/catalogue.mjs writes it, --check says whether it is current). Every status is 'planned' until code and a measurement exist.

priorities.P2: common, with a permission or a native part that matters

apis.title: Files and key-value storage
apis.native: files in the app's own directory; survives clearing the web view's data

apis.title: Secure storage (Keychain, Keystore, Credential Locker)
apis.native: hardware-backed secrets

apis.title: App lifecycle: pause, resume, back button, memory warning
apis.native: the back button of Android, memory warnings, state restoration

apis.title: Deep links and universal links
apis.native: the OS hands the app a URL

apis.title: Share sheet
apis.native: the native share sheet and share targets (receiving)

apis.title: Clipboard
apis.native: clipboard without a user gesture where the OS allows it

apis.title: Haptic feedback
apis.native: impact, selection and notification feedback of the OS

apis.title: Safe area, status bar, orientation, keyboard insets
apis.native: status bar style, orientation lock, the keyboard's height

apis.title: Device and OS information
apis.native: model, OS version, locale, battery, free space

apis.title: Network status and type
apis.native: connection type, metered, reachability events

apis.title: Permission state and requests
apis.native: the OS prompts and the settings page

apis.title: Open a URL in the system browser or another app
apis.native: a custom tab, another app by scheme

apis.title: Local notifications
apis.native: scheduled notifications, channels, badges

apis.title: Push notifications
apis.native: APNs and FCM tokens, silent pushes

apis.title: Camera and photo library
apis.native: the OS picker, saving to the library

apis.title: File picker and save dialog
apis.native: the OS document picker and share-to-files

apis.title: Location, including background
apis.native: background updates, significant-change, geofences

apis.title: Biometric and device-credential unlock
apis.native: local authentication that gates the app or a secret

apis.title: Keep the screen on
apis.native: the same, where the web view lacks the API

apis.title: Media controls, lock screen, audio session
apis.native: audio focus, background audio, remote commands

apis.title: Motion, orientation, compass
apis.native: the same without a permission dance in each web view

apis.title: Bluetooth LE
apis.native: CoreBluetooth and the Android stack

apis.title: NFC
apis.native: reading and writing tags on both OSes

apis.title: Background work
apis.native: scheduled and long-running tasks within the OS's limits

apis.title: In-app purchases and subscriptions
apis.native: StoreKit and Play Billing

apis.title: Sign in with Apple, Google
apis.native: the native sign-in sheets

apis.title: Contacts and calendar
apis.native: reading and writing, with the OS permission

apis.title: Speech recognition and synthesis
apis.native: on-device recognition

apis.title: Printing and PDF export
apis.native: the native print dialog from a document

apis.title: Remote control keys: D-pad, back, play/pause, colour keys
apis.native: media and colour keys the web view does not deliver

apis.title: Spatial navigation: focus that follows the D-pad
apis.native: a focus model for apps without a pointer (shared with the editors' roving focus)

apis.title: 10-foot UI: overscan, safe margins, resolution
apis.native: display modes, HDR, frame-rate matching
